scientific_assessments.result: The regular case explicitly assumes a proper positive target, symmetric proposal independent of persistent signed v, and mandatory v rescaling on every accepted move. The accepted inverse Jacobian pi(y)/pi(x) produces pi(y)q(x,y)/2 and matches the reverse contribution for symmetric q. The asymmetric negative control is correctly excluded from the guarantee.

scientific_assessments.topic: Composition, stationary acceptance and momentum context
scientific_assessments.result: The record correctly separates threshold-substep reversibility from full augmented-chain reversibility. It limits ordinary-Metropolis recovery under fresh uniforms to the x process, and limits equal mean acceptance to stationarity with the same proposal. Fixed height requires no shift, no noise, and no other state update. The momentum claim retains partial refresh, one leapfrog proposal with negation, joint-density acceptance/rescaling and final negation.

scientific_assessments.topic: Pair target and guarded conditional kernel
scientific_assessments.result: The pair transition (a,b) to (b,c), mu(a,b)=pi(a)T(a,b), conditional balance and domination are indexed consistently. The Liu formula and exclusion-proposal equivalence match Equation16. The point-mass guard retains a in the conditional update after the swap, so it yields (b,a), not a frozen complete pair.
